caption: Refined warm minimal electronica for a calm task-list app film. Rounded electric piano and a subtle airy analog texture, a warm lightly syncopated bass, and tiny brushed electronic drums. A memorable understated melodic idea develops with small variations and answering phrases, playful but composed; gentle optimism, mental clarity and relief, never sleepy or excited. Plenty of silence between gestures; subtle human swing and varied articulation. A through-composed miniature score, not a loop: a spacious 4-second introduction; a subtle rhythmic entrance under typing; small evolving phrases through the middle; a warm harmonic opening around 19 seconds; a gentler, lighter passage after 24 seconds; percussion drops out around 30 seconds; a reassuring final cadence around 33 seconds with a natural fading tail. Instrumental only, no voices, no vocal chops. Intimate, dry, uncluttered studio mix with softened transients, clear midrange and real dynamic breathing. No dramatic build, no big drop, no cymbal wash, no corporate anthem.
